data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Obie total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_hebrew.name: עביה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Obie is derived from the Hebrew word 'ob' meaning 'my father' and 'yah' meaning 'he is exalted'. It can be translated as 'my father is exalted' or 'exalted father'.

in_greek.name: ὦβιας
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Obie in Greek is derived from the word 'οὗ' (oh) meaning 'my' and 'βιας' (bias) meaning 'god'. It can be translated as 'Father of God' or 'God the Father'.

in_latin.name: Obieus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Obie in Latin is derived from the Latin word 'Obieus' which can be translated as 'God is my strength'. It is a rare name in the Latin scripture.
